title: Case Title (ex: Next Level Bootcamp - Ramp-up Reduction)
role: Role Title (ex: Marketing Coordinator / Product Enablement Expert)
context_pt: Contexto: Descreva o cenário de mercado/empresa. Qual era o ambiente? Quais as condições?
context_en: Context: Describe the market/company scenario. What was the environment? What conditions?
challenge_pt: Desafio: Qual era o problema de negócio ou técnico específico a ser resolvido?
challenge_en: Challenge: What was the specific business or technical problem to solve?
problem_pt: Problema Negocial/Técnico: A dor exata. O que estava quebrado, faltando ou ineficiente?
problem_en: Business/Technical Problem: The exact pain point. What was broken, missing, or inefficient?
hypotheses_pt: Hipóteses Formuladas: O que você acreditava que resolveria o problema? Qual o racional analítico?
hypotheses_en: Hypotheses Formulated: What did you believe would solve the problem? What was the analytical rationale?
decisions_pt: Decisões & Arquitetura: O que você decidiu fazer? Qual solução criou? (IAs, automações n8n, estratégias GTM)
decisions_en: Decisions & Architecture: What did you decide to do? What solution did you create? (AIs, n8n automations, GTM strategies)
tradeoffs_pt: Trade-offs & Riscos Assumidos: Quais compromissos fez? O que sacrificou? Riscos calculados?
tradeoffs_en: Trade-offs & Risks: What compromises did you make? What did you sacrifice? Calculated risks?
results_pt: Resultados & Métricas: Impacto quantificável (+150% adoção IA, -50% ramp-up, 505 leads, R$ 50k revenue)
results_en: Results & Metrics: Quantifiable impact (+150% AI adoption, -50% ramp-up, 505 leads, R$ 50k revenue)
star_situation_pt: Situation: Contexto da história STAR (onde, quando, qual o cenário)
star_situation_en: Situation: STAR story context (where, when, what scenario)
star_task_pt: Task: Qual era sua responsabilidade específica? O que precisava ser entregue?
star_task_en: Task: What was your specific responsibility? What needed to be delivered?
star_action_pt: Action: O que VOCÊ fez especificamente? (verbos de ação: liderou, desenhou, implementou, otimizou)
star_action_en: Action: What did YOU specifically do? (action verbs: led, designed, implemented, optimized)
star_result_pt: Result: Qual o resultado mensurável? Use números, %, antes/depois.
star_result_en: Result: What was the measurable outcome? Use numbers, %, before/after.
